subject: IRS
topic: The Holy Quran, revelation and the life of Prophet Muhammad
body: Which angel brought the Quranic revelation to Prophet Muhammad (SAW)?
explanation: Jibril (Gabriel) was the angel who conveyed Allah's revelation to the Prophet. Mikail, Israfil and Izrail have other duties.

subject: IRS
topic: The Holy Quran, revelation and the life of Prophet Muhammad
body: The first verses revealed to Prophet Muhammad (SAW) belong to which surah?
explanation: The first five verses revealed, beginning "Iqra" (Read), are from Surah Al-Alaq (96).

subject: IRS
topic: The Holy Quran, revelation and the life of Prophet Muhammad
body: What was the name of the mother of Prophet Muhammad (SAW)?
explanation: His mother was Aminah bint Wahb. Halimah was his foster-mother, Khadijah his first wife and Fatimah his daughter.

subject: IRS
topic: The Holy Quran, revelation and the life of Prophet Muhammad
body: How many surahs (chapters) are in the Holy Quran?
explanation: The Quran has 114 surahs, from Al-Fatihah to An-Nas.

subject: IRS
topic: The Holy Quran, revelation and the life of Prophet Muhammad
body: The Hijrah of Prophet Muhammad (SAW) in 622 CE was a migration from Makkah to which city?
explanation: The Prophet migrated to Yathrib, later renamed Madinah. The Islamic calendar begins from this event.

subject: IRS
topic: The Holy Quran, revelation and the life of Prophet Muhammad
body: Before he became a prophet, the Makkans called Muhammad (SAW) "Al-Amin". What does it mean?
explanation: Al-Amin means the trustworthy. He earned the title through his honesty in dealings and in keeping people's goods safe.

subject: IRS
topic: The Holy Quran, revelation and the life of Prophet Muhammad
body: About how old was Prophet Muhammad (SAW) when Jibril first came to him in the Cave of Hira?
explanation: He received the first revelation at about 40 years of age, in the month of Ramadan. He died at 63.

subject: IRS
topic: The Holy Quran, revelation and the life of Prophet Muhammad
body: Who headed the team that first collected the Quran into one written volume under Caliph Abu Bakr?
explanation: After many Quran memorisers died at Yamamah, Zaid ibn Thabit, the Prophet's scribe, was told to compile the Quran.

subject: IRS
topic: The Holy Quran, revelation and the life of Prophet Muhammad
body: Which caliph ordered standard copies of the Quran to be made and sent to the major Muslim cities?
explanation: Caliph Uthman had standard copies made to end differences in recitation and sent them to major cities. Abu Bakr only compiled the first volume.

subject: IRS
topic: The Holy Quran, revelation and the life of Prophet Muhammad
body: Which of these is a typical feature of Madinan surahs?
options: Short verses with oaths on natural phenomena
Rulings on community life such as inheritance and dealings with hypocrites
Warnings addressed mainly to the idol worshippers of Makkah
Mostly the story of Adam only
explanation: Madinan surahs, revealed after the Hijrah, deal with law and social organisation. Makkan surahs stress belief, resurrection and warnings.

subject: IRS
topic: The Holy Quran, revelation and the life of Prophet Muhammad
body: Which surah describes the Night of Decree as better than a thousand months?
explanation: Surah Al-Qadr (97) says Laylatul Qadr is better than a thousand months. It is the night the Quran began to be revealed.

subject: IRS
topic: The Holy Quran, revelation and the life of Prophet Muhammad
body: The Treaty of Hudaybiyyah in 6 AH was agreed between the Muslims and which group?
explanation: At Hudaybiyyah, near Makkah, the Prophet agreed a ten-year truce with the Quraysh. The Muslims returned that year and performed Umrah the next.

subject: IRS
topic: The Holy Quran, revelation and the life of Prophet Muhammad
body: About how many Muslim fighters took part in the Battle of Badr in 2 AH?
explanation: The Muslims at Badr numbered about 313, against a Quraysh army of about 1,000. They won with Allah's help.

subject: IRS
topic: The Holy Quran, revelation and the life of Prophet Muhammad
body: At what age did Prophet Muhammad (SAW) die in Madinah in 11 AH (632 CE)?
explanation: He lived about 63 years: 40 before prophethood, 13 in Makkah after it, and 10 in Madinah after the Hijrah.

subject: IRS
topic: The Holy Quran, revelation and the life of Prophet Muhammad
body: Which act of worship was prescribed during the Prophet's Isra and Miraj?
explanation: During the Miraj, the five daily salat were made obligatory on the Muslims. Fasting, Zakat and Hajj were prescribed later in Madinah.

subject: IRS
topic: The Holy Quran, revelation and the life of Prophet Muhammad
body: Which is the longest surah of the Holy Quran?
explanation: Surah Al-Baqarah (2) has 286 verses and is the longest. Al-Imran, An-Nisa and Al-Maidah are also long but shorter.

subject: IRS
topic: The Holy Quran, revelation and the life of Prophet Muhammad
body: Which surah is the only one that does not begin with "Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim"?
explanation: Surah At-Tawbah (9) opens without the Bismillah. Al-Anfal, Yunus and Al-Ahzab all begin with it.

subject: IRS
topic: The Holy Quran, revelation and the life of Prophet Muhammad
body: Who was the first free adult man to accept Islam after the Prophet (SAW) announced his mission?
explanation: Abu Bakr was the first free adult man to accept Islam. Umar and Hamza accepted it later, and Bilal was a former slave who accepted Islam early.

subject: IRS
topic: The Holy Quran, revelation and the life of Prophet Muhammad
body: Which Christian king of Abyssinia gave protection to the early Muslim refugees fleeing Makkah?
explanation: The Negus of Abyssinia refused to hand the Muslim emigrants over to the Quraysh. Heraclius ruled Byzantium and Muqawqis ruled Egypt.

subject: IRS
topic: The Holy Quran, revelation and the life of Prophet Muhammad
body: Which of these was a recognised mode of revelation (wahy) to Prophet Muhammad (SAW)?
options: Writing on stone tablets in Makkah
explanation: True dreams were one mode of wahy. Others included a bell-like sound and Jibril appearing as a man. Tablets and the burning bush relate to Musa.
